shortDescription: Run Pester tests on Windows hosts

options.name: output_format
options.description: Format of the test report to be generated. This parameter is to be used with output_file option.

options.name: path
options.description: Path to a pester test file or a folder where tests can be found. If the path is a folder, the module will consider all ps1 files as Pester tests.

options.name: tags
options.description: Runs only tests in Describe blocks with specified Tags values. Accepts multiple comma separated tags.

options.name: test_parameters
options.description: Allows to specify parameters to the test script.

options.name: version
options.description: Minimum version of the pester module that has to be available on the remote host.
